content:
sam (perf): quick drop: ran short bench across us-west-2 and eu-central-1 comparing H100 fp16 vs A10 int8 for 40B model. sending p50/p95 + tok/s samples and a short capacity calc.

sam (perf): TL;DR: H100 wins p95 under load, A10 wins cost per token at mid concurrency. regional p95 uplift ~10-15% in eu on H100.

alex (infra): paste the numbers and your assumed concurrency targets?

sam (perf): test config: single model, no beam, prompt 64, gen 128. concurrency sweep per-GPU: 1,4,8,16. batching on, max_batch_tokens=2048.

sam (perf): us-west-2 samples:
```
H100 fp16  - c=1  p50 58ms  p95 170ms  tok/s 430
H100 fp16  - c=8  p50 78ms  p95 310ms  tok/s 2950
A10 int8   - c=1  p50 98ms  p95 320ms  tok/s 230
A10 int8   - c=8  p50 145ms p95 540ms  tok/s 1520
```

sam (perf): eu-central-1: +10-15% p95 on H100 across sweep, A10 throughput ~5% lower vs us-west.

marta (ml-eng): quant note: A10 int8 used per-channel sym quant pipeline. quick quality spot-check on critical prompt set: ~2% drop on rare-token completions (BLEU/ROUGE proxy).

alex (infra): for Dedicated sizing, are we locking to 8 concurrency/gpu as baseline? looks like sweet spot for throughput before p95 jumps.

sam (perf): we defined tiers: low-latency (1-2), mid (4-8), burst (16+ relaxed p95). proposing slab approach: define slab = capacity unit. H100 slab = 8x target concurrency, A10 slab = 12x per price-equivalent slab.

jin (oncall): autoscale/warmup question: observed KV cache cold-fill penalty ~2s on H100 for first request after cold. what's warm buffer plan?

sam (perf): recommend warm buffer 20-30% if strict p95 SLO, 0-10% if cost-first mid-tier. warm job reduced cold p95 by ~40%.

marta (ml-eng): fallback policy: if automated eval detects >1.5% regression on critical prompt set, route to fp16 H100 variant in-region. cost ~1.6x but preserves quality.

sam (perf): capacity calc example I used:
```
# GPUs_needed = ceil(peak_rps * avg_tokens / (tok_s_per_gpu * util_target))
peak_rps=120
avg_tokens=200
tok_s_gpu=2950  # H100 @8
util=0.75
=> gpus=ceil(120*200/(2950*0.75)) = ceil(24000/2212.5) = 11
```

alex (infra): for Dedicated quotes run two fleet mixes: 70% H100 /30% A10 and 100% H100. simulate 1-week burst pattern and include cross-region fallback penalties.

sam (perf): will run sims tomorrow. hypothesis: mixed fleet saves ~12-18% cost with <5% p95 violations if routing prioritizes H100 for latency-sensitive routes.

jin (oncall): ops ask: can deploy-bot create a warm-pool-on-scale job to pre-warm 20% of new capacity on scale-up? that should cut cold penalties.

deploy-bot: created job warm-pool-on-scale for pools labeled dedicated-40b, warm_ratio=0.20. :white_check_mark:

marta (ml-eng): add a sim where one AZ loses A10s (AZ outage) to validate fallback headroom and cross-region latency impact.

sam (perf): added AZ outage variant to sim plan and included an egress/latency penalty model. will upload CSVs + charts to eng-platform bench folder and ping.

alex (infra): include token cost, expected burst runway, and per-slab price-equivalent mapping. also run sensitivity where avg_tokens increases by 25%.

sam (perf): added sensitivity sweep. early result: mixed fleet requires ~10-15% more total gpus for worst-case AZ outage but still cheaper overall vs 100% H100 for steady-state.

marta (ml-eng): if sim shows >2% regressions in fallback scenarios, we'll tighten quant thresholds or reduce A10 allocation on latency-sensitive routes.

sam (perf): any objections to slab sizing and warm-buffer defaults?

alex (infra): none. next: schedule cost+SLO review tomorrow 10am PT. include recommended slab counts for 1k, 5k, 10k peak rps profiles.

sam (perf): will deliver sim artifacts and recommended slab tables. posting results thread shortly.
